title: If a bearing-ring spheroidising furnace quote includes nitrogen protection, is the nitrogen generator included too?
summary: Nitrogen protection in a proposal does not necessarily mean that a nitrogen generator is included in the equipment quotation. Two bearing-ring spheroidising annealing furnace documents from Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd., dated May 2026, set different boundaries: one explicitly excludes nitrogen supply equipment, while the other lists nitrogen-generation equipment and states that Suneng will purchase it from its manufacturer. Separate the furnace gas circuit from the gas-source equipment before comparing responsibilities.
